steps.what: Read scripts, books, plays and news content and explore ideas for production
Discuss creative fit and select material or ideas to be produced

tasks.design: Keep material selection with the producer, using {DOCS} to retain candidate versions and the editorial brief. Reading, discussion and the creative choice stay human because a summary or ranking cannot establish the value of producing the material.
tasks.previous_blocker: Creative potential and audience fit do not follow a stable selection rule.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing native document records can support traceable choices; no new automation is needed for the decision.
tasks.still_hard: Promising ideas may be unusual, incomplete or difficult to compare, and their quality emerges through creative discussion.
tasks.human_edge: The producer recognises a distinctive idea and takes responsibility for developing it.
tasks.altitude: Creative reading, discussion and selection rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess material against audience and editorial priorities

evidence.claim: Choosing material for production requires contextual creative judgement; no labour saving is inferred from text summarization capability.

assumptions: Boundary is evaluating and selecting material, excluding acquiring rights, detailed budgeting, casting, commissioning contracts and producing the chosen work. Candidate sourcing and selection actions must have a single owner in a team roll-up.

Authors, editors or idea originators produce candidate material through existing work. Producer reads it and captures assessment within s1, then discusses and records the choice within s2; no free structured quality or rights-clearance flag is assumed.

The internal choice does not itself acquire rights or authorize public use. Rights and feasibility constraints are checked through existing responsible specialists before commitments outside this boundary.
Keep native document versions and current meetings. No new system, capture requirement or maintenance process is introduced; incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: How editorial authority and commissioning authority are divided
Whether candidate material has already received specialist rights and feasibility review
research_questions: Can the producer trace each chosen idea to its exact material version and stated production constraints?

already_counted.description: Read material, evaluate creative potential, discuss fit and record the selection

incremental.description: No changed workflow or new upkeep

approvals.approved_version: Exact chosen material or recorded idea version, editorial brief and stated constraints; a material change requires a new selection decision

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, incremental focal upkeep=0 and net=0. Reading and creative discussion retain their full time; no administrative work is invented to create a saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The producer retains responsibility for which stories and ideas deserve production.
reach: Explore editorial commissioning with media programming directors
skills_to_grow: Assess unusual material in its full context
Connect audience needs to creative intent
role.ambitious_version: Choose distinctive material through informed creative judgement and make the reasons for the choice traceable.
